name: Genesis SRC
about: Genesis SRC (2001-034D, NASA/JPL), launched 2001 Aug  8. Its phases from GCAT: SEL1, Earth, SEL2, UTTR. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
